tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: This connection's workspace: its plan, the plan's limits and features, and whether trading is switched off. Call it first when unsure what the user can do. Example: {}

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: This month's usage against the plan, and its cost so far in minor units (9900 is $99.00). Over quota opening is refused, closing never is. Example: {}

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The workspace's MT5 accounts with id, login, server, state and environment (demo or live); use the id, not the login, everywhere else. Only `ready` accounts trade, so bring the others online first. Example: {"limit": 25}

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: One account: login, broker, state, environment, and its last-read balance, equity and free margin. Example: {"account_id": "<id from list_accounts>"}

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Just an account's state, cheap enough to poll every few seconds after bring_accounts_online until `ready`. States invalid_credentials, needs_2fa, needs_certificate and trading_disabled need the user, so stop polling. Example: {"account_id": "<id>"}

tools.name: get_account_figures
tools.description: Balance, equity, margin, free margin and margin level as decimal strings in the account currency, read every 15 s while online. Set fresh to ask the terminal now (the account must be `ready`). Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "fresh": true}

tools.name: bring_accounts_online
tools.description: Starts each account's MT5 terminal in the cloud and logs it in; poll get_account_status until `ready`. Places no trades and is safe to repeat. Example: {"account_ids": ["<id>"]}

tools.name: take_account_offline
tools.description: Stops an account's terminal; open positions and their stops stay at the broker. Refused while an order is in flight. Example: {"account_id": "<id>"}

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: Open positions on one account as last observed; brokerPositionId is what close_position and modify_position take. Pages with limit and cursor. Example: {"account_id": "<id>"}

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Markets named once (XAUUSD, US30, BTCUSD) whatever each broker calls them. list_account_instruments gives one account's own symbol for each. Example: {"category": "metals"}

tools.name: search_broker_servers
tools.description: MT5 broker servers matching a broker or server name, servers seen working on fxapis first. A server not listed can still be used. Example: {"query": "icmarkets"}

tools.name: list_account_instruments
tools.description: Each instrument's symbol on this account's broker: mapped, ambiguous (with candidates) or missing. Trade the mapped symbol. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "query": "XAU"}

tools.name: get_market_hours
tools.description: Whether a market is open now on this account's broker, and when it next opens or closes, in UTC. A broker holiday missing from its schedule still refuses orders. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "instrument": "XAUUSD"}

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Live bid and ask for up to 20 symbols or instruments from this account's broker; a closed market answers its last price with marketOpen false. The account must be online. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "instruments": ["EURUSD"]}

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Orders placed through fxapis, newest first, for one account or all; state `unknown` means still being confirmed, so never resend those. Pages with cursor. Example: {"state": "unknown"}

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: The authoritative record of one order: what was asked, the broker's answer, fill volume and price. Poll it after ORDER_UNRESOLVED until it leaves `unknown`. Example: {"order_id": "<id>", "include_deals": true}

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: An account's deal history as the broker recorded it, newest first, including stops that fired, swaps and manual trades. Realised profit is here. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "since": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"}

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: The margin an order would need, or its profit between two prices, as the broker computes it; opens nothing. The account must be online. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "kind": "margin", "symbol": "EURUSD", "side": "buy", "volume": "0.10", "price": "1.08450"}

tools.name: place_market_order
tools.description: Opens a position at market on the user's real broker account (or demo) and waits for the broker; confirm account, symbol, side and volume with the user first. On ORDER_UNRESOLVED never resend, poll get_order. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "symbol": "EURUSD", "side": "buy", "volume": "0.10", "idemp

tools.name: place_pending_order
tools.description: Places a limit or stop order on the user's real broker account (or demo) that waits at the broker; success means working, not filled. Confirm it with the user first. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "symbol": "EURUSD", "side": "buy", "kind": "limit", "volume": "0.10", "price": "1.08000", "idempotency

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Closes a position on the user's real broker account (or demo), whole or by volume. Sent twice it opens the opposite position, so reuse an idempotency_key only to retry the same close. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "position_id": "<brokerPositionId>", "idempotency_key": "<new uuid>"}

tools.name: modify_position
tools.description: Moves a position's stop loss or take profit on the user's real broker account (or demo); null removes a level. Remove a stop loss only when the user asks. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "position_id": "<brokerPositionId>", "stop_loss": "1.08000", "idempotency_key": "<new uuid>"}

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels a pending order on the user's real broker account (or demo) that has not triggered. If it triggered there is a position to close instead. Example: {"order_id": "<id>", "idempotency_key": "<new uuid>"}

tools.name: list_multi_account_orders
tools.description: Recent multi-account orders (one trade on many accounts), each with its per-account result. Pages with limit and cursor. Example: {}

tools.name: get_multi_account_order
tools.description: One multi-account order and each account's result; poll it after placing one. An account left `unresolved` must not be resent, so poll its order instead. Example: {"multi_account_order_id": "<id>"}

tools.name: place_multi_account_order
tools.description: Places the same market order on many of the user's real broker accounts (or demo) at once and returns at once; follow it with get_multi_account_order. Confirm the accounts, symbol, side and volume with the user first. Example: {"account_ids": ["<id>", "<id>"], "instrument": "XAUUSD", "side": "buy",

tools.name: cancel_multi_account_order
tools.description: Calls off a multi-account order on the user's real broker accounts (or demo) before anything is sent. Once orders went out, close the positions instead. Example: {"multi_account_order_id": "<id>", "idempotency_key": "<new uuid>"}

tools.name: get_account_overview
tools.description: One account in one call: state, environment, balance and equity, and its largest open positions with their total P/L. Start here when asked how an account is doing. Example: {"account_id": "<id>"}

tools.name: get_symbol_snapshot
tools.description: One symbol on one account in one call: its specification, live quote, whether the market is open, and the margin for a volume. Use it before proposing a trade. Example: {"account_id": "<id>", "instrument": "XAUUSD", "volume": "0.10", "side": "buy"}

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
